title: Sexual Immorality Defiles the Church

questions.question: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among the Corinthians, and of a kind that is not tolerated even among pagans. What was someone doing?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 5:1 (ESV): "It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and of a kind that is not tolerated even among pagans, for a man has his father's wife."

questions.question: And you are arrogant! Ought you not rather to ____?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 5:2 (ESV): "And you are arrogant! Ought you not rather to mourn? Let him who has done this be removed from among you."

questions.question: Even though Paul is absent in body, he is present in spirit, and has already pronounced judgment. What does he say to do with this man when they are assembled in the name of the Lord Jesus?
options: Deliver this man to Satan for the destruction of the flesh
Whip him according to the law of Moses
Forbid him from taking communion until he repents
Make him confess publicly before the elders
questions.correctAnswer: Deliver this man to Satan for the destruction of the flesh
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 5:5 (ESV): "you are to deliver this man to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, so that his spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord."

questions.question: Why deliver this man to Satan for the destruction of the flesh?
options: So that his spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord
So that an example may be made to the whole church
So that the wrath of God may not fall upon the congregation
Because he has rejected the Holy Spirit
questions.correctAnswer: So that his spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 5:5 (ESV): "you are to deliver this man to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, so that his spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord."

questions.question: Your boasting is not good. Do you not know that a little ____ leavens the whole lump?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 5:6 (ESV): "Your boasting is not good. Do you not know that a little leaven leavens the whole lump?"

questions.question: Cleanse out the old leaven that you may be a new lump, as you really are unleavened. For Christ, our ____, has been sacrificed.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 5:7 (ESV): "Cleanse out the old leaven that you may be a new lump, as you really are unleavened. For Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed."

questions.question: Let us therefore celebrate the festival, not with the old leaven, the leaven of malice and evil, but with the unleavened bread of ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 5:8 (ESV): "Let us therefore celebrate the festival, not with the old leaven, the leaven of malice and evil, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth."

questions.question: Paul wrote to them in his letter not to associate with sexually immoral people. He says he did not at all mean the sexually immoral of ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 5:9-10 (ESV): "I wrote to you in my letter not to associate with sexually immoral people—not at all meaning the sexually immoral of this world, or the greedy and swindlers, or idolaters, since then you would need to go out of the world."

questions.question: Why did Paul not mean avoiding the immoral of this world, the greedy, swindlers, or idolaters?
options: Because then you would need to go out of the world
Because it is the world's nature to sin
Because God alone judges the world
Because you are called to preach to them
questions.correctAnswer: Because then you would need to go out of the world
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 5:10 (ESV): "not at all meaning the sexually immoral of this world, or the greedy and swindlers, or idolaters, since then you would need to go out of the world."

questions.question: Paul says he is writing to them not to associate with anyone who bears the name of brother if he is guilty of sexual immorality or greed, or is an idolater, reviler, drunkard, or swindler. What should they not even do with such a one?
options: Not even eat with such a one
Not even speak to such a one
Not even pray with such a one
Not even greet such a one
questions.correctAnswer: Not even eat with such a one
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 5:11 (ESV): "But now I am writing to you not to associate with anyone who bears the name of brother if he is guilty of sexual immorality or greed, or is an idolater, reviler, drunkard, or swindler—not even to eat with such a one."

questions.question: For what have I to do with judging ____? Is it not those inside the church whom you are to judge?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 5:12 (ESV): "For what have I to do with judging outsiders? Is it not those inside the church whom you are to judge?"

questions.question: Who judges those outside the church?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 5:13 (ESV): "God judges those outside. 'Purge the evil person from among you.'"

questions.question: What is the final instruction Paul gives in chapter 5 regarding the man who sinned?
options: "Purge the evil person from among you."
questions.correctAnswer: "Purge the evil person from among you."
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 5:13 (ESV): "God judges those outside. 'Purge the evil person from among you.'"

questions.question: By comparing sin to a little leaven that leavens the whole lump, what danger is Paul warning the Corinthian church about?
options: That tolerating known sin in the church will corrupt the entire congregation
That small sins will lead to greater sins in an individual's life
That pride is the root of all other evils
That the teachings of false apostles spread very rapidly
questions.correctAnswer: That tolerating known sin in the church will corrupt the entire congregation
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 5:6-7 (ESV): "Your boasting is not good. Do you not know that a little leaven leavens the whole lump? Cleanse out the old leaven that you may be a new lump..."

questions.question: Which of these vices is NOT included in Paul's list in 5:11 of types of "brothers" to not associate with?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 5:11 (ESV): "...if he is guilty of sexual immorality or greed, or is an idolater, reviler, drunkard, or swindler..." Murder is not explicitly in this specific list.

key_verse_text: Your boasting is not good. Do you not know that a little leaven leavens the whole lump? Cleanse out the old leaven that you may be a new lump, as you really are unleavened. For Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed.
